caption.line: See what a job did, and cost
caption.sentence: Press a reply to see its steps, how long they took, and what its harness says they cost.

caption.line: Set what a job may spend
caption.sentence: When a job here reaches the amount you set, Chips holds the agents until somebody lets them carry on. Only costs a harness reports count.
Press a reply and tell Milo what's wrong. Milo reads it, and can try again.

caption.line: See when an agent can't answer
caption.sentence: If an agent's harness is offline, the space says so under your message.
